'''Yari Cranna-Rapier''' was a holo-entertainer. She was featured in the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] ''[[Rodian Kisses]]''.

Yari married [[Jobal Rapier]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], but the couple got separated two and a half years later, which, among other reasons, was admittedly done for press publicity.
